name: prose
description: Four selectable output styles for Claude Code: ELI5 (plain language, everyday analogies, every term defined), ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), STELI5 (ELI5's explaining under STE's sentence discipline), and VONNEGUT (tiny chapters, a homely analogy per mechanism, subject-verb-object sentences). All four change only how Claude writes to you - normal coding behaviour, code, paths and commands are untouched.
